name: fluid-hover-highlight
title: Fluid Hover Highlight
description: One highlight that glides between list rows under the pointer or keyboard focus instead of blinking on hover.

props.name: rect
props.description: Box to highlight in the container's coordinate space. null fades the highlight out.

props.name: session
props.description: Changes on each pointer enter, so a fresh highlight fades in instead of travelling.

props.name: from
props.description: Where a fresh highlight fades in from, for example a checked row.

props.name: transition
props.description: Positional spring. false snaps with no travel.

props.name: className
props.description: Radius, colour and z-index of the highlight.
